text: Mousavi et al. (2013) showed that a family of plant genes homologous to animal ionotropic glutamate receptors is required for what process?
choices: Propagation of electrical wound signals from one leaf to another
Sensing gravity via amyloplast sedimentation in statocytes
Producing the airborne signal methyl jasmonate
Silencing the FLC gene during vernalization
explanation: Plant GLUTAMATE RECEPTOR-LIKE (GLR) genes act as ligand-gated calcium channels and mediate leaf-to-leaf electrical wound signaling, the strongest molecular link between plant electrical signaling and animal synaptic machinery. Gravity sensing relies on amyloplasts (choice 1), methyl jasmonate is a jasmonate derivative (choice 2), and FLC silencing is a Polycomb-based chromatin process (choice 3).
